connector.name: CPersona
connector.registryDescription: Persistent AI memory in one SQLite file: 3-layer hybrid search, confidence scoring, 29 tools.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package cpersona. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the cloto-dev account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: CPERSONA_DB_PATH
env.description: SQLite database path. Defaults to data/cpersona.db, which follows the client's working directory — set it to an absolute path to keep one memory across sessions.

env.name: CPERSONA_EMBEDDING_MODE
env.description: Embedding mode: 'http' to use an embedding server for vector search, 'none' for lexical layers only.

env.name: CPERSONA_EMBEDDING_URL
env.description: Embedding server endpoint, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8401/embed. Required when CPERSONA_EMBEDDING_MODE=http.
